post.title: 5 Tips for Healthy Teeth
post.description: Simple daily habits to keep your teeth strong and your smile bright.

content.text: Maintaining good oral hygiene is essential for overall health.
Use a fluoride toothpaste and brush for at least two minutes each time.
Flossing removes plaque and food particles from between teeth that a toothbrush cannot reach.
Limit sugary snacks and drinks. Choose fruits, vegetables and dairy for strong teeth and gums.
An antiseptic mouthwash helps kill bacteria and freshens breath.
Schedule a check-up and professional cleaning every six months.

items.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
items.answer: Modern root canal treatment is performed under local anaesthesia and is no more uncomfortable than a routine filling. Most patients are surprised at how painless the procedure is.
